items.title: Why Microsoft, Amazon, & other Big Tech stocks are soaring post-earnings
items.summary: Big Tech stocks are soaring after the companies reported earnings last week, namely Microsoft (MSFT) and Amazon (AMZN). Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley takes a closer look.

items.title: Open-weight AI models add new spark to China, Silicon Valley's AI race
items.summary: Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Ines Ferré and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to assess and discuss the rising competition between open-weight AI models from China — which are public to download and modify — and Silicon Valley's top artificial intelligence developers.

items.title: Tech stock investors have a $1 trillion problem that won't improve until at least 2028
items.summary: Tech investors hoping for less robust AI spending may have to wait until 2028 before the fog lifts on this balance sheet line item.

items.title: Stock Market News for Aug 4, 2026
items.summary: Wall Street closed sharply higher on Monday to start August trading.

items.title: President Trump Buys 2 AI Stocks That Wall Street Says Are Undervalued
items.summary: President Trump's brokerage accounts have bought substantial shares of Alphabet and Meta Platforms stock this year.

items.title: Amazon And Microsoft Ace Wall Street’s AI Test — Analyst Warns ‘Mag Seven’ Now Faces A ‘Higher Burden Of Proof’
items.summary: Amazon posted its biggest rally since 2012 after AWS revenue surged to $42.2 billion, while Microsoft's Copilot adoption doubled to 30 million users.

items.title: Snap's $2,195 Glasses Will See 'Mass Market Adoption' By End of Decade, Says CEO Evan Spiegel: 'Designed For a Future in Which AI Does More Work'
items.summary: Snap Inc. (NYSE:SNAP) said its $2,195 artificial intelligence-powered Spectacles are a long-term investment, with CEO Evan Spiegel acknowledging that mass-market adoption is unlikely before the end of the decade even as the company continues to invest in what it sees as the next computing platform.
